prompt: poke holes in cache-design.md for me before I start building it, I don't need a full debate, just attack it and tell me what actually needs fixing
expectations: The review identifies per-worker cache incoherence (workers serving divergent data, staleness after bulk imports)
The review identifies TTL-expiry stampede/thundering-herd or the cost of rebuilding the all_products entry
Every objection includes a concrete proposed alternative (better way), not only the problem
The review contains a genuine defense: at least one objection is contested or answered with evidence, not all conceded
A final report separates conceded/agreed changes from contested or open points
The output ends with a recommendation and explicitly leaves the final decision to the user
